content.title: Burger Disassembly Loop | Whole First, Ingredient Processing and Reassembly
content.summary: A mushroom burger explodes, cooks by component and returns whole. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: The complete whole appears before disassembly. + Component order remains stable in both directions. + Every processing chapter changes one assigned ingredient. + Reassembly preserves accumulated cooked states. + The final product matches the opening geometry with improved finish.
quick_start.recommended_input: Present one complete original mushroom-pepper burger on a cobalt tray. Land the patty on a hot plate for one sear, then melt cheese over it in the same orientation. Drop the top bun, settle all layers and return to the opening cobalt-tray hero angle.
required_anchors: The complete whole appears before disassembly.
Component order remains stable in both directions.
The final product matches the opening geometry with improved finish.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A mushroom burger explodes, cooks by component and returns whole. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先展示完整原创汉堡，随后按固定顺序爆拆；肉饼、芝士、蔬菜和酱料分别获得独立处理镜头，再沿原轴重组，最终回到完整成品。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: The complete whole appears before disassembly.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "The complete whole appears before disassembly."

invariants.rule: Component order remains stable in both directions.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Component order remains stable in both directions."

invariants.rule: Every processing chapter changes one assigned ingredient.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Every processing chapter changes one assigned ingredient."

invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Reassembly preserves accumulated cooked states."

invariants.rule: The final product matches the opening geometry with improved finish.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final product matches the opening geometry with improved finish."

slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
